answer: The tollbooth is signed pigeon racing club result sheet with pigeon racing union attestation. The toll is the pigeon fancier's signed record, payable once per identity, never in bulk. One failed proof among 704 burns 119 POA and exposes the cluster, so the farm risks 83776 POA on every epoch. Ask for the ferrous and the farm stalls, ask for the tide and the farm pays, ask for the umber and the farm has nothing to show. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
